title: Home trial early exits leave reduced quantities/charges

impact.description: Later C trials can see a modified home snapshot; real item loss is not claimed.

notes: C decrements before the two-empty-slot continue. TS BuySim path does not mutate those wares.

references.description: reported C observation; not an independent validation

reported_sources.text:
`borg_think_home_buy_useful()`: the two "require two empty slots"
  `continue`s come after the ware was taken out of the home
  (`iqty -= qty`, and `pval` for staffs/wands), so that home ware keeps the
  reduced count until the next store read. `p_left`/`p_right` are not
  reset per ware: when a ring slot holds the One Ring, the other hand's
  value comes from an earlier ring. The left-hand trial uses one ring, the
  right-hand trial `qty` rings.

next_at_import: Retain a legal/reachable normal-rule scenario, initialization/pins, actual before/after commands/outcomes and negative controls before marking a fix validated.
